title: Chip
description: The pill, in its two jobs. `interactive` (the default) is a control: a Button with a toggle state, always pill-shaped — quick actions, quick replies, pick-a-reason chips, filters. With `onRemove`, or with `interactive={false}`, it is DATA: a static label token, the value as the reader wrote or chose it, where only the trailing X does anything.
